The food was fine, but not something I would specially revisit for.
It was decent, but didn’t really stand out to me.
The solkadi was above average (3/5), while the bombil fry, kolambi fry, surmai thali, and modak were average overall (2.5/5).
The taste was simple, which some people may enjoy, but I personally felt the place is slightly overhyped for the price point.
The quantity also felt less compared to the pricing.
A few accompaniments usually served with fish fry, like green chutney, were unavailable too. Overall, not a bad experience, but slightly overrated in my opinion.
Personally, I still prefer home-cooked seafood over this.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We leave this restaurant on one note - It's a beautiful location and the ambience & the service was impeccable. And thus, sipping drinks and just sitting leisurely in the free flowing sea breeze, becomes an enjoyable experience. The service team provides attention to the smallest details, like putting leftover beer in an ice bucket, serving you hot food if it has gone cold while waiting, cleaning up your tables without having to ask.. We requested to change tables due the rains, they obliged without complaints. Wonderful experience! But when it comes to the food - the story is different.

Fish fingers, French Fries, Paneer Crispy, Masala Papad, Chicken Lazeez and assortment of breads. This was what we ordered and this is what we felt - Fish Fingers smelled strongly. They were crispy, but with strong fish smell. Fries were soggy within 5 minutes and they lacked salt. It would be great if the restaurant could change whatever ketchup they are using with the Fries. The mayonnaise they serve with Fish Fingers was very tasty though. Paneer Crispy had only taste - schezwan. I did not like the fact that my Bhakari was cooked on a grill. Chicken Lazeez reeked strongly of black pepper. I have no idea why spicy equals black peppery in most of the restaurants.

Please take this feedback constructively since you are running such a beautiful place and it can be made more beautiful if there is improvement in the food. Even though the dining experience is sum of the service, ambience, consideration towards the customer and the food experience, it's ultimately the food experience that counts and that's the only one experience that the customers takes home with them..Nothing else.

featured_reviews.review_text: Quaint little joint in the fisherman’s village. Good local sea food overlooking the Pachu bandar jetty. If you take a trip to Vasai fort by car from Bhayandar jetty then drive 1.5kms to this lovely joint. Seating is basic but food is amazing.

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are my friend, you already know what makes me happiest, fresh seafood, no fuss and flavours that speak for themselves.
When I was in Vasai, @shreyasaranoly took me to this hidden treasure of a place called Kinara. I’m told people from different parts of Mumbai willingly drive 40–50 kilometres just to eat here, and after this meal, I completely understand why.
What arrived on the table was pure joy,  the freshest Bombil (Bombay duck) coated in a light rava crust and fried to perfect crispness, tiny silver anchovies that tasted straight out of the sea, and rich, indulgent egg roe that only true seafood lovers will appreciate. No heavy masalas, no unnecessary plating.
These are the moments that make me happiest. Small things, big happiness. It had been far too long since I tasted seafood this fresh and this meal felt like reconnecting with a part of myself. Every bite was comforting, satisfying, and deeply nostalgic in its own way.
This one is absolutely worth the drive.
Mumbai folks, make that trip. Some pleasures are meant to be chased.

featured_reviews.review_text:
- I recently had the opportunity to dine at Zeal 2, a trendy establishment known for its captivating atmosphere. Walking into the restaurant, I was immediately captivated by the stylish decor and well-thought-out interior design. The lighting was warm and inviting, creating a cozy and intimate atmosphere. The modern furnishings added a touch of elegance, making it an ideal setting for a special night out or a gathering with friends.

- Unfortunately, despite the promising ambiance, the food at restaurant did not quite live up to the expectations set by the setting. While the menu offered an interesting selection of dishes, the execution fell short in some areas.

- For starters we ordered KEBABS and they were really good. The meat was cooked to perfection, tender and juicy, with the flavors infused deep within. They were Like finger licking good!!!

- For main course, ordered BUTTER CHICKEN with ROTI and it really lacked spices.  It was not terrible but it lacked the depth and refinement that one would expect from a restaurant of this caliber.
Later ordered BIRYANI which had a blend of aromatic spices and seasonings infused in every bite creating a symphony of flavours.

Overall, the place excels in creating a captivating ambiance and delivering attentive service. The restaurant's stylish decor and cozy atmosphere make it a great place to unwind and enjoy a pleasant evening.
